annotations.title: List my buying queries and who AI names

description:
Every buying query in the latest scan: which engines named the brand,
    which answered without naming it, and the firms they named instead. A query
    here is one question; each engine's answer to it is counted separately in
    the Tofu Index. Read an engine's full answer with get_query_answers.

brand.description: A brand's id, website or name from list_workspaces. Leave empty for the workspace's main brand.
brand.title: Brand

only_missing.description: Only the queries where at least one engine answered and did not name you.
only_missing.title: Only Missing

workspace.description: A workspace id from list_workspaces. Leave empty for the one picked when TofuBofu was connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

name: list_queries
